placements.title: Ratified asynchronous job protocols govern execution and result delivery

placements.title: Immediate receipts and cursor polling replace blocking extraction calls
placements.frame: How does returning immediate receipts coupled with cursor polling or piggybacking prevent blocking while guaranteeing no lost work?
placements.why: Captures the core architectural shift of remember dispatching receipts in seconds and tracking extraction asynchronously via polling or piggybacked reactions without losing client state.
